# Bloodborne Research Commons

Evidence-qualified knowledge about Bloodborne engine internals, PC porting, reverse engineering and validation. This is an optional discovery index, not a source of execution authority.

- [README](README.md): project status and boundaries
- [Start here](START_HERE.md): task-oriented reading workflow
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): evidence, safety and contribution contract
- [Evidence policy](docs/EVIDENCE_POLICY.md): levels, claims and counterexamples
- [Source registry](sources/projects.yaml): pinned upstream versions
- [Source review](docs/SOURCE_REVIEW.md): how the claims and license notes were checked, and what was not
- [Claim: GX registry](claims/RC-0001-gx-resources.md): public resource identity descriptions
- [GX lifecycle dossier](knowledge/gx-resource-lifecycle.md): pinned implementation, downstream safeguards, completion distinctions and unresolved guest-source lifetime
- [Texture preparation lifetime dossier](knowledge/texture-prep-source-lifetime.md): route-specific source completion and original texture-owner ordering limit; independent review pending at r1
- [Claim: Differential testing](claims/RC-0002-decomp-compare.md): original-code comparison methodology
- [Claim: bbport callgraph](claims/RC-0003-callgraph-limits.md): static scanner scope
- [Resource lifetime frontier](frontiers/resource-ownership.md): open game-resource questions
- [Continuation protocol](docs/CONTINUATION.md): how to return a useful investigation
- [Publication check](docs/PUBLICATION_CHECK.md): owner decision and verified publication record
- [License](LICENSE): CC BY 4.0 for original documentation (adopted); [adoption record](docs/LICENSE_PROPOSAL.md)
